scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
That Veronica...
Hah! Best hair dresser my ass.
She's not the best hair dresser...
...
I am!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
那個維羅妮卡...
哈！什麼最好的髮型師，真是笑話。
她根本不是最好的髮型師...
...
我才是！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
I, Rui Vishop, the man to whom
all scalps are canvases
waiting to be transformed into
works of magnificent art~!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
我，魯伊·維紹普！在我眼裡，每個腦袋都是畫布，等待著被打造成華麗的藝術品~！

scripts.text: What are you?
scripts.translation: 你是誰？

scripts.text: Do my hair, please!
scripts.translation: 請做個髮型

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Do you not know that I, Rui
Vishop, maestro of the shears
and sculptor of hair, am an
artist far ahead of his time?!
Well, I suppose an adventurer
like yourself wouldn't know...
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
你不知道嗎？我，魯伊·維紹普，剪刀的大師，
頭髮的雕塑家，是一位超越時代的藝術家！
不過，像你這樣的冒險者大概是不懂的...

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
As a hair sculptor, I find joy
in bestowing upon others the
supreme favour of doing their
hairstyle at a reasonable price.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
作為一名髮型雕塑家，我樂於以合理的價格，
賜予他人做髮型的無上恩惠。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Recently, however, I happened to
overhear that some tyro has had
the audacity to call herself a
hair dresser.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
可最近聽說，有個初出茅廬的新手竟敢自稱髮型師。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
So one day I went there,
pretending to be a customer.
I was apalled to see the boring,
lifeless hairstyles that she was
giving all of her clients...
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
於是有一天，我裝成顧客去看了看。
她給顧客做的髮型乏味又死板，真讓我大吃一驚...

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
It wasn't hard to notice that her
skills, or lack thereof, are a
joke. She brings shame to the
great and honorable
profession of hair dressing.
A complete and utter disgrace!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
她那點技術，不，根本沒技術，簡直是個笑話。
她給這份偉大又光榮的職業蒙了羞，真是奇恥大辱！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
But the worst part was...
she forced her customers to
choose a hairstyle before she
styled their hair!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
最糟糕的是...她竟然讓顧客先選髮型，再動手！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
That's not how talented hair
dressers do their job! She
should know what hair style will
fit a customer without ever
asking them!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
有才華的髮型師怎麼能這樣！
不用開口問，也該知道什麼髮型最適合顧客！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
If by any chance you decide to
do your hair, don't even think
about giving her patronage.
Instead, you may ask for my
services. I assure you, I am
faaaar better than her.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
想做髮型的話，千萬別去找她，來找我吧。
我保證，比她強得多——！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Do you understand? I mean, don't
let her ruin your hair needlessly!
You could get a Swordman to hack
away at your hair if you want a
hairstyle that horrible~!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
明白嗎？別白白讓她毀了你的頭髮！
想要那麼難看的髮型，找個劍士亂砍幾下就行了~！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Hmm, I must say, your current
style fits you best. Trust me, I know what I am saying.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
嗯，你現在的髮型就是最適合你的。
相信我，我可懂行。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Ah, I see that that you can
recognize genius when it is
right before you. In light
of your good taste, I will
only require money for my
services.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
啊，看來你認得出眼前這位天才。
看在你這麼有眼光的份上，我就只收錢好了。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Simply pay me the small
fee of 199,800 zeny. You must
know that I am doing you a
huge favor by charging you
such a small amount. My
art is priceless, after all.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
只需支付我199,800 Zeny的小額費用。
你應該知道，我收取這麼少的錢
是在給你天大的恩惠。畢竟，
我的藝術是無價的。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Alright, I will be taking my
199,800 zeny service charge now.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
好，那就收你199,800 Zeny服務費。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
If you don't wish to do
this right now, though I can't
imagine why, you may ask that
stupid hair dresser to
do her clumsy work on you...
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
要是現在不想做，雖然我實在想不通為什麼...你也可以去找那個笨蛋髮型師，讓她胡亂擺弄你的頭髮...

scripts.text: No, please do my hair.
scripts.translation: 請幫我做髮型

scripts.text: Umm, I changed my mind.
scripts.translation: 改變主意了

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
O~k~a~y!
Now, let us begin~!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
好~的~！
那麼，讓我們開始吧~！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Wooooo~oooohhhh!! Toohhhhh~oooohhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
Wooooo~oooohhhh!! Toohhhhh~oooohhhh!!

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Woooooo~aaaaaaahhhhh!!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
Woooooo~aaaaaaahhhhh!!

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Voila!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
看！完成了！

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Oh, great~ it's awesome!
Another Vishop masterpiece~
Once more I've outdone myself.
It's such a unique and talented
style! Yes, I am the best! Wooohahahahahaha!
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
哦，太棒了~真完美！又一件維紹普的傑作~
我再次超越了自己，多麼獨特又充滿才華的造型！
沒錯，我才是最棒的！Wooohahahahahaha!

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
Bah! Alright! It's your decision.
But don't blame me later!
One day you'll wake up, realize
you're ugly and regret not
having my genius shape every lock
of hair on your head.
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
哼！隨你吧，可別回頭怪我！
總有一天，你會突然發現自己有多難看，後悔沒讓我的天才技藝照料頭上每一縷頭髮。

scripts.text:
[Rui Vishop]
What? What a shame!
Will you let that...that
charlatan of a hair dresser ruin
your hairstyle!? I'm sure the
heavens are crying tears of
pity at mankind's ignorance...
scripts.translation:
[魯伊·維紹普]
什麼？太可惜了！
你寧願讓那個...那個冒牌髮型師毀了你的頭髮嗎？！
上天一定正在為人類的無知流下悲憫的淚水...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Wah?! Sweet Jiminy,
you freaked me out!
What are you doing?!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇？！天哪，
你嚇死我了！
你在幹什麼？！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh! Um, a customer!
H-h-h-h-h-hello! Can
I help you with anything?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哦！嗯，有顧客！
你...你好！
有什麼可以幫你的嗎？

scripts.text: What do you do?
scripts.translation: 你是做什麼的？

scripts.text: Please change my hairstyle.
scripts.translation: 請換個髮型

scripts.text: Who is Prince Shammi?
scripts.translation: 王子 沙米是誰？

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh! Me...? I'm
just an assistant
beautician, but I'm
training hard everyday
so that I can become
a real professional!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我...？我只是個美容助理，不過每天都在努力練習，希望成為真正的專業髮型師！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Yeah, I do all sorts of
grunt work for the boss while
I'm in training. Sometimes, he
makes me work pretty hard.
In fact, I better get back to work before he gets angry at me!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
學徒期間，我幫老闆做各種雜活，有時還挺累的。
對了，得趕緊回去幹活，免得老闆生氣！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Me...? Oh no,
no I can't! I mean,
I'd love to but, I'm
still in training and
I can't take responsibility
if I mess up on a little kid!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我...？不、不行！
雖然很想幫忙，可我還在學習，萬一把小孩子的髮型做壞了，我可承擔不起！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Well... I'm just an
assistant, but I have been
studying hairstyling after
work. If you want, just bring
me 250,000 zeny and I'll try
my best to change your hair~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我只是個助理，不過下班後也一直在學髮型設計。
你願意的話，給我250,000 Zeny，我就盡全力幫你換個髮型~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
I'd appreciate it if you'd
give me this chance! The
boss doesn't think I'm ready
for styling real people yet, so
I haven't had much practice!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
能給我這個機會，我會非常感激！
老闆覺得我還不能給真人做髮型，所以一直沒什麼機會練習！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
I just know I could
do a good job on your
hair! Just... Just please
understand if I mess up.
It won't be too bad, I promise~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
我相信能給你做個好髮型！
只是...萬一搞砸了，請多包涵。
不會太糟的，我保證~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
You're really going to
give me a chance to practice?
Oh, I love you so much! Okay,
I'll need 250,000 zeny to make
up for the material expenses.
Is that okay with you?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
真的願意給我練習的機會？太愛你了！
不過，需要250,000 Zeny材料費，能接受嗎？

scripts.text: Of course~
scripts.translation: 當然~

scripts.text: On second thought...
scripts.translation: 再想想...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Great! Now, please
choose a hairstyle
from ''1'' to ''23.''
Um, if you need to
cancel, just enter ''0.''
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
太好了！請選擇1到23號髮型。
想取消的話，輸入0。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Awwww...
I guess you don't
trust me after all...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哎呀...
看來你終究還是
不信任我嘛...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Huh? I thought I asked
you to enter a number from
''1'' to ''23?'' What did I do
wrong this time? Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
咦？我不是說請輸入1到23之間的數字嗎？
這次我又哪裡弄錯了？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
So this is the
style you want me
to try to do for you?
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
想讓我試著做這個髮型，對嗎？

scripts.text: Yes, let's try it~
scripts.translation: 是的，試試看~

scripts.text: Cancel.
scripts.translation: 取消

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oooh, there must
be some style that
you like, right? Hmmm...
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
總有你喜歡的髮型吧？嗯...

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Great, you finally
picked one! What, which
one did you pick again?
Ah, I found it, I found it!
Haha! No problem here!
Now it's time to style!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
太好了，終於選好了！
什麼，你選的是哪個來著？啊，找到了！
Haha!沒問題，開始做髮型啦！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Bwwwwaaaahhhh!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
Bwwwwaaaahhhh!

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Yap! Pwwwaaattt!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
Yap! Pwwwaaattt!

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Waaaah!
Oh crap!
Wait, I can...
I can fix this!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
哇啊！
糟糕！
等等，我可以...
我可以補救的！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
^333333*Pant Pant Pant*^000000
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
^333333*Pant Pant Pant*^000000

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Bwahahaha! Success!
So... How do you like
your new style? I love it!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
Bwahahaha!成功！
怎麼樣，喜歡新發型嗎？我很喜歡！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Bwahahaha! Success!
Wha...? This isn't what
you wanted? Uh oh... Um...
Well, next time I know I can
do a much better job! Right!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
Bwahahaha!成功！
什麼...不是你想要的？糟了...嗯...
下次我肯定能做得更好！沒錯！

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Oh, you're such a
sweetheart for helping
me! Thank you for using
my service and come again~
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
你真好，願意幫我！
謝謝你來做髮型，歡迎再來~

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Huh? Oh no, you're
quitting? Well, I guess
I couldn't trust me to
style my hair either...
You're... You're right.
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
咦？不做了？
好吧，換作我，大概也不敢讓自己這種水平的人做髮型...
你...你是對的。

scripts.text:
[Assistant Beautician]
Prince Shammi?
He's only a genius when
it comes to hairstyling!
I'm just his apprentice, but
maybe someday, I can be a
force in the fashion world too!
scripts.translation:
[美容助理]
王子 沙米？他可是髮型設計方面的天才！
我只是他的學徒，不過，也許有一天，我也能在時尚界闖出名堂！
